title: NASA labels the Sun's central pressure and central density as model values
summary: Under the heading Model values at center of Sun, the sheet lists central pressure 2.477 × 10^11 bar and central density 1.622 × 10^5 kg/m^3.
body: The Sun fact sheet has a heading "Model values at center of Sun:" and under it prints central pressure 2.477 x 10^11 bar (2.477 x 10^17 g/cm s^2) and central density 1.622 x 10^5 kg/m^3 (1.622 x 10^2 g/cm^3). The same heading also covers the central temperature already recorded on world.sun-fact-sheet. These center values are labeled model values by the sheet. They are not bulk-parameter cells. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
